blocks.text: An auto-fit grid chooses how many columns can fit. minmax gives each column a useful minimum and lets it share extra room.

blocks.title: Make a grid that fits

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `minmax` gives a grid track a minimum and maximum size. The `1fr` maximum shares extra room with other flexible tracks.
`auto-fit` fits as many grid tracks as the available width can support, then distributes the remaining space.
`grid-template-columns` defines the column tracks. Each listed size or repeated track describes a column.

blocks.text: The number of columns changes with the space. Each card can shrink to the full available width on a very narrow screen.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A minimum wider than the screen can still overflow. The inner min(100%,12rem) avoids that.
